Executive Summary

The site has a severe indexing problem: only 45 out of ~2,922 articles (1.5%) are indexed by Google. The vast majority of pages (1,948) are in "Discovered - currently not indexed" status, meaning Google knows these URLs exist but hasn't prioritized crawling them. This is the single biggest blocker to organic traffic growth.

Performance is low but showing signs of life — 41 clicks and 1,370 impressions in the last 3 months, with one article (automating-data-pipelines-ai-practical-guide) seeing a 222% spike in impressions. The brand query "beehive strategy" drives 19 of the 41 clicks (46%). Improving indexing is the #1 lever for growth.

What "Discovered - currently not indexed" means

Google has found these URLs (via sitemaps, internal links, or external links) but hasn't crawled them yet. This is common for sites with many pages and limited crawl budget. The fix is not technical — it's about building authority and giving Google reasons to prioritize your content. Key levers:

  • Ensure sitemap includes all URLs (currently missing ~770 articles)Fix
  • Build internal links from indexed pages to unindexed onesImprove
  • Build external backlinks to increase crawl priorityImprove
  • Fix title tags & meta descriptions for better quality signalsFix
  • Request indexing for high-priority URLs via URL InspectionAction

Priority Action Plan

P0 — Critical

Fix 44 server errors (5xx)

Impact: 44 pages are returning server errors, preventing Google from crawling them. These are actively harming crawl efficiency and site quality signals.
Fix: Check Cloudflare Pages deployment logs for 5xx errors. Verify these URLs don't have broken middleware or missing files. Use GSC URL Inspection to identify specific failing URLs.
P0 — Critical

Regenerate sitemaps with all 974 articles per language

Impact: ~770 articles are missing from the sitemap. Google can't discover URLs it doesn't know about. Sitemap currently has 2,152 discovered pages but site has ~2,922 articles.
Fix: Scan all article directories and regenerate sitemap-blog-{en,zhcn,zhtw}.xml. Resubmit sitemap in GSC.
P0 — Critical

Investigate 10 pages blocked by robots.txt

Impact: 10 pages are being blocked from crawling. Need to verify if this is intentional or a robots.txt misconfiguration.
Fix: Check robots.txt rules, identify which URLs are blocked, and either fix the rules or confirm the block is intentional.
P0 — Critical

Fix title tags — add brand suffix to 648 EN articles

Impact: 66% of EN titles lack | Beehive Strategy suffix. Poor titles = poor CTR. "beehive" query gets 220 impressions but 0 clicks.
Fix: Append brand suffix to all article titles. Ensure titles stay under 60 chars.
P1 — High

Investigate 77 "Crawled - currently not indexed" pages

Impact: Google crawled these pages but chose not to index them. This signals quality/thin content issues or canonical problems.
Fix: Use GSC URL Inspection to check specific URLs. Improve content quality, ensure unique content, check for canonical issues. Validation already failed — need to make substantive improvements.
P1 — High

Fix 2 pages excluded by 'noindex' tag

Impact: 2 pages have noindex tags preventing indexing. Check if this is intentional.
Fix: Identify the 2 URLs and remove noindex meta tags if they should be indexed.
P1 — High

Address Core Web Vitals INP issue

Impact: GSC sent an alert about INP (Interaction to Next Paint) issues. While no data is showing yet, this will affect rankings once CWV data populates.
Fix: Run Lighthouse audit on key pages, optimize JavaScript execution, reduce layout shifts, improve response times.
P2 — Medium

Request indexing for high-priority URLs

Impact: For the 1,948 "Discovered" pages, we can manually request indexing for high-value articles via GSC URL Inspection.
Fix: Identify top 50 priority articles, use GSC URL Inspection to request indexing for each. Limited to ~10-20 requests per day.
P2 — Medium

Improve CTR for high-impression queries

Impact: "beehive" gets 220 impressions but 0 clicks. Title and meta description need to be more compelling.
Fix: Rewrite title tags and meta descriptions for pages targeting high-impression queries. Front-load keywords, include value propositions.
P3 — Low

Monitor GSC messages and validation status

Impact: 6 unread messages, several validation processes in progress. Need to monitor for fix confirmations or new issues.
Fix: Check GSC weekly for message updates and validation status changes.
